cards.card_text: Then the LORD says, “And I will bring upon you everlasting shame and perpetual humiliation that will never be forgotten.”
cards.verse_text: And I will bring upon you everlasting shame and perpetual humiliation that will never be forgotten.”
cards.snippet: And I will bring upon you everlasting shame and perpetual humiliation that will never be forgotten.”

cards.card_text: Then the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, describes what's coming for them: “a place of weeds and salt pits, a perpetual wasteland.” Perpetual, friend, that's not a fixer-upper, that's a FOR SALE sign NOBODY ever takes down.
cards.verse_text: Therefore, as surely as I live,” declares the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, “surely Moab will be like Sodom and the Ammonites like Gomorrah—a place of weeds and salt pits, a perpetual wasteland.
cards.snippet: …and the Ammonites like Gomorrah—a place of weeds and salt pits, a perpetual wasteland.
